translations.web: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
translations.bsb: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
translations.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought
